product.name: Lanternfish
product.what: A night-shift log for lighthouse keepers.
product.for_whom: Experienced lighthouse keepers on night shifts, and the harbour authorities who buy it.
product.value: Keepers log about forty entries a shift quickly at their desk terminal; authorities read a weekly summary.
product.meaning: A small, steady light kept in the dark: the log keeps watch with the keeper.

groups.name: Keepers
groups.summary: Experienced keepers who log all night at a desk terminal in a dim lamp room.

groups.name: Harbour authorities
groups.summary: Buy the log for every light they run and read the weekly summary.
